narration: Compare each guess against the real token. Measure how wrong it was, as one number.
caption: हर अंदाज़े को असली टोकन से मिलाओ। ग़लती को एक नंबर में नापो।
image_brief: Two paper cards clipped side by side on a wire line, one showing a word and one showing a different word, a single digit chalked on the wall beneath them, cool overhead light.

narration: Then nudge millions of internal numbers slightly toward a better guess. Slightly. Not dramatically.
caption: फिर लाखों भीतरी नंबरों को बेहतर अंदाज़े की तरफ़ ज़रा-सा खिसकाओ।
image_brief: A wall of small brass dials on a control panel, each one turned a fraction away from centre, fingerprints on the metal between them, warm low light from the side.

narration: Repeat across an enormous pile of written text. Billions of tiny corrections, one after another.
caption: लिखाई के बड़े ढेर पर यही अरबों बार दोहराओ, छोटे-छोटे सुधारों के साथ।
image_brief: A towering stack of loose printed pages rising above a desk edge, the top sheets faintly smudged from handling, a stub of pencil balanced on top, dim light.

narration: Because the only goal is the next token, everything it learns must serve that goal.
caption: मक़सद सिर्फ़ अगला टोकन है, तो जो भी सीखा जाता है उसी के लिए।
image_brief: A single narrow doorway at the end of a bare corridor, every object in the corridor angled toward it, the floor scuffed in one direction, hard light from the doorway.

narration: Grammar helps prediction. So grammar gets absorbed, without one rule ever being taught explicitly.
caption: व्याकरण अंदाज़े में मदद करता है, तो वह बिना सिखाए ही सीख लिया जाता है।
image_brief: A closed grammar textbook lying under a thin film of dust on a shelf, its spine uncracked, a neatly written page beside it on the shelf edge, soft window light.

narration: Facts that appear together help prediction. So those pairings get absorbed too. Capital. City. Country.
caption: साथ आने वाले तथ्य भी मदद करते हैं, तो वे जोड़े भी सीख लिए जाते हैं।
image_brief: Two words printed on separate slips lying overlapped at one corner on dark wood, a faint ink line linking them, other slips scattered much further away, low light.

narration: Reasoning steps appear in written text. So the shape of reasoning gets absorbed as well.
caption: तर्क के चरण भी लिखाई में मिलते हैं, तो उनका ढाँचा भी सीख लिया जाता है।
image_brief: A worked arithmetic proof handwritten down a long sheet of paper in numbered steps, the final line left blank, the sheet curling at the bottom, plain desk light.

narration: Now watch it run. Your prompt arrives as tokens, in order, all at once.
caption: अब चलता हुआ मॉडल देखिए। आपका सवाल टोकन बनकर एक साथ पहुँचता है।
image_brief: A row of numbered paper tiles lined up along a shallow wooden tray, their edges touching, the tray resting on a desk with a clean empty surface behind, even light.

narration: Each token looks back at the earlier tokens. It weights which ones actually matter here.
caption: हर टोकन पिछले टोकनों को देखता है और तय करता है कौन ज़्यादा मायने रखता है।
image_brief: A row of wooden tiles with fine threads running backward from the last tile to several earlier ones, the threads varying in thickness, dark table, low side light.

narration: That weighting is attention. It is how surrounding context steers the very next guess.
caption: इस तोल को अटेंशन कहते हैं। संदर्भ इसी से अगला अंदाज़ा मोड़ता है।
image_brief: A ship's wheel mounted on a plain post, held in position mid-turn by two tensioned ropes pulling from opposite sides, salt-worn wood, overcast light.

narration: The model finishes with a score for every token in its vocabulary. Every single one.
caption: आख़िर में मॉडल अपनी पूरी शब्द-सूची के हर टोकन को एक अंक देता है।
image_brief: An enormous printed ledger opened flat across two desks, every line carrying a short fragment and a number, the columns running off the visible edge, cool light.

narration: Scores become probabilities. One token is picked. It joins the sentence and stays there.
caption: अंक संभावना बनते हैं। एक टोकन चुना जाता है और वाक्य में जुड़ जाता है।
image_brief: A single paper tile lifted out of a crowded tray and set at the end of an existing row of tiles, the gap it left visible behind it, warm directional light.

narration: Then the whole computation runs again, with that new token now part of the input.
caption: फिर पूरा हिसाब दोबारा चलता है, नए टोकन को भी इनपुट में लेकर।
image_brief: A hand-cranked mill wheel at rest on a stone base, grain heaped in the feed chute with one extra kernel sitting on top, flour dust in the air, low light.

narration: So an answer is a chain of local guesses. Nothing ever checks the whole thing.
caption: यानी जवाब स्थानीय अंदाज़ों की एक कड़ी है। पूरे को कोई नहीं जाँचता।
image_brief: A long metal chain laid in a winding line across a concrete floor, every link sound, no inspection tag anywhere along its length, harsh overhead industrial light.

narration: Numbers make this concrete. The figures here are illustrative, chosen because they are easy to follow.
caption: अब उदाहरण। यहाँ के आंकड़े समझाने के लिए हैं, असली नाप नहीं।
image_brief: A clean sheet of graph paper on a desk with a mechanical pencil and a plain calculator set beside it, nothing written on the page yet, bright neutral daylight.
